correctness.rationale: The exact identity x(1−x)B'(x)=(a−nx)B(x) identifies the unique peak p, and differentiation there gives h B''(p)=−nβ_* for h=p(1−p)>0. At criticality the solution above p decreases to p by the sign of the field and uniqueness; there (1/(x−p))' tends to nβ_*/2, giving the claimed reciprocal-time limit. For passage, the continuous extension of [β_*−B(p+y)]/y² is positive on the whole fixed passage interval and equals D=−B''(p)/2 at zero. After y=√ε u, extend the integrand by zero outside the rescaled interval and dominate by a constant times 1/(1+u²); the limit integral is π/(h√D), giving the stated coefficient. The subcritical split follows from the same quadratic expansion and monotonicity. Straighten the moving face by using c−β and holding β fixed along each trajectory; the two transverse diagonal entries of the critical Jacobian have the stated strictly negative signs. The invariant one-dimensional restriction has nonzero quadratic term −nβ_*/2 and detuning derivative −h, so is the parameter-dependent fold reduction, not an off-face timing claim. Exact polynomial differentiation and independently rescaled quadrature at three quorums confirm the coefficients; for N=5,M=3 the constants are 4/3 and 4π/√3.
residual_risks: Quadrature is corroboration only. The passage interval is fixed and strictly interior, time is normalized as in Eq. (10), and neither timing constant was proved off the invariant face.

value.rationale: Knowing the cooperation threshold alone does not quantify loss times near it. The two normalizations let one compare quorums in the same clock: β_* t(x−p) tends to 2/n, whereas √(ε/β_*) β_* T tends to π√(2n/(ad)), shortest at balanced quorums for fixed n. This exact contrast and the face's transverse stability give a specific use for the constants in interpreting long near-threshold transients. The value is not the generic saddle-node scaling exponents or a claim about generic initial conditions.
residual_risks: The timing comparison is for trajectories on the invariant face and interior quorums only.
